items.title: Tencent Hy4 is live on Together AI
items.snippet: Tencent Hy4 is live on Together AI. We tested its image input by extracting and rebuilding a chart, then tried its coding with a browser game generated from one prompt.

items.title: Introducing Together Storage Accelerator: fast, free data caching for your GPU cluster
items.snippet: Together Storage Accelerator is a distributed caching layer for Together GPU Clusters: about 20x faster warm reads, one origin fetch per cluster, no application changes, and it's included free.
